user.title: Recipe Book
user.description: Adds a Recipes page to the sidebar. Recipes are stored as YAML files in /config/recipe_book/.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Recipe Book is already set up.

reload_recipes.name: Reload recipes
reload_recipes.description: Reads the recipe files again, for files changed outside Home Assistant.

add_recipe.name: Add recipe
add_recipe.description: Saves a new recipe to its own file.

category.name: Category
category.description: Used to filter recipes. Empty means Uncategorised.

serves.name: Serves
serves.description: How many people it serves. Default 2.

status.name: Status
status.description: Untested, Attempted or Approved. Default Untested.

ingredients.name: Ingredients
ingredients.description: One ingredient per line, or a list.

steps.name: Steps
steps.description: One step per line, or a list.

update_recipe.name: Update recipe
update_recipe.description: Overwrites a recipe's file with these values. The uuid stays the same.
